name: Venda, tipus general 4,5 %
description: Lliurament de béns o prestació de serveis a Andorra subjecte a l’IGI al tipus general
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 57 — the general rate is 4.5 % and applies whenever no other rate is expressly provided. Return line 1: the base and the IGI charged at the general rate.

name: Venda, tipus especial 2,5 %
description: Transport de persones i per cable, entrades a parcs temàtics, serveis culturals i altres operacions de l’article 60 bis
legal_reference: Llei 10/2014, article adding article 60 bis to Llei 11/2012 — the special rate is 2.5 % and applies only to the listed operations: cable transport and its marketing, passenger transport, tickets to animal theme parks and thermal-leisure centres, cultural services not supplied by public or non-profit bodies, works of art and collectors’ items. In force from 1 July 2014 (Llei 10/2014, final provision four).

name: Venda, tipus reduït 1 %
description: Aliments i begudes no alcohòliques, aigua, llibres, diaris i revistes, classes particulars sobre matèries d’estudis
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 58 — the reduced rate is 1 % and applies only to the listed operations: private lessons on school and university subjects, food and non-alcoholic drinks for people and animals, live animals, seeds and plants, water, and books, newspapers and magazines that are not mainly advertising. Return line 3.

name: Venda, tipus super reduït 0 %
description: Serveis sanitaris, socials, educatius, esportius i culturals d’entitats públiques o sense ànim de lucre
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 59 — the super-reduced rate is 0 % and applies only to the listed operations: hospital and health services of public bodies, care by health professionals under an agreement with the Caixa Andorrana de Seguretat Social, social assistance, schooling and child care, sport and cultural services of public or non-profit bodies, and the other items of the article. A supply at 0 % is a taxable supply: the input tax stays deductible. Return line 4.

name: Venda, tipus incrementat 9,5 %
description: Prestacions de serveis bancaris i financers
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 60 — the increased rate is 9.5 % and applies to banking and financial services. Return line 5.

name: Venda exempta, exportació
description: Lliurament de béns expedits o transportats fora d’Andorra, amb dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 14 — deliveries of goods shipped or transported out of the territory of the tax are exempt, on the conditions the regulation sets. The right to deduct the input tax is kept. Return line 6.

name: Venda exempta, altres operacions
description: Operacions interiors exemptes sense dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, chapter three (exempt operations carried out inside the territory). One code carries the whole list; which item applies is the preparer’s judgement and the chapter was not read item by item. An exempt supply carries no IGI. Return line 7.

name: Compra, tipus general 4,5 %, deduïble
description: Adquisició de béns o serveis a Andorra amb IGI deduïble
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 61 and 62 — a taxable person deducts the IGI borne on the goods and services received for the business. Return line 10 (deductible input tax on domestic purchases).

name: Compra, tipus especial 2,5 %, deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI al 2,5 %, deduïble
legal_reference: Llei 10/2014, article 60 bis, with articles 61 and 62 of Llei 11/2012 — input tax at 2.5 % is deductible for a taxable person. Return line 10.

name: Compra, tipus reduït 1 %, deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI a l’1 %, deduïble
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 58, 61 and 62 — input tax at 1 % is deductible for a taxable person. Return line 10.

name: Compra, tipus incrementat 9,5 %, deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI al 9,5 %, deduïble
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 60, 61 and 62 — input tax at 9.5 % is deductible for a taxable person. Return line 10.

name: Compra, tipus general 4,5 %, IGI no deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI al tipus general que no dona dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 63 — limits on the right to deduct: input tax on goods and services not used exclusively for a taxable activity is not deductible and is a cost of the purchase. The base is reported on return line 11; the tax is posted on the expense.

name: Compra exempta o a 0 %, sense IGI
description: Adquisició sense IGI repercutit
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 58 and 59 for the 0 % rate and chapter three for the exemptions — no IGI is charged, so no input tax is recorded.

name: Importació de béns, IGI al 4,5 % pagat a la Duana
description: Béns importats, IGI liquidat a la Duana
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 55(6) — on imports the shifting of the tax is done by the document issued by the customs; articles 14 to 41 for the exemptions on import. Return line 9: the base and the IGI paid at the border, deductible by a taxable person.

name: Compra, tipus especial 2,5 %, IGI no deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI al 2,5 % que no dona dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 10/2014, article 60 bis, with article 63 of Llei 11/2012 — input tax not used exclusively for a taxable activity is not deductible and is a cost of the purchase. Base on return line 11.

name: Compra, tipus reduït 1 %, IGI no deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI a l’1 % que no dona dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 58 and 63 — input tax at 1 % not used exclusively for a taxable activity is not deductible and is a cost of the purchase. Base on return line 11.

name: Compra, tipus incrementat 9,5 %, IGI no deduïble
description: Adquisició amb IGI al 9,5 % que no dona dret a deducció
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, articles 60 and 63 — input tax at 9.5 % not used exclusively for a taxable activity is not deductible and is a cost of the purchase. Base on return line 11.

name: Importació de béns, IGI al 2,5 % pagat a la Duana
description: Béns importats al tipus especial, IGI liquidat a la Duana
legal_reference: Llei 10/2014, article 60 bis, applied to imports with article 55(6) of Llei 11/2012 — the shifting of the tax on an import is done by the customs document. Return line 9.

name: Importació de béns, IGI a l’1 % pagat a la Duana
description: Béns importats al tipus reduït, IGI liquidat a la Duana
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 58 applied to imports with article 55(6) — the shifting of the tax on an import is done by the customs document. Return line 9.

name: Importació de béns, IGI al 9,5 % pagat a la Duana
description: Importació amb IGI al tipus incrementat liquidat a la Duana
legal_reference: Llei 11/2012, article 60 applied to imports with article 55(6) — the shifting of the tax on an import is done by the customs document. Return line 9.
